document.information: The MPEs are defined by the standard as a radiant exposure or and irradiance. When we compare an actual exposure to the MPE, we have to average the exposure over a limiting aperture (which is also defined by the standard).
document.question:
Consider two {{Power|quant}} lasers. One laser has a {{Diameter|quant}} flat top beam profile and the other has a {{Diameter|quant}} 1/e Gaussian beam profile. How much power is transmitted through a {{ApertureDiameter|quant}} limiting aperture for each laser? Compute the energy tranmitted through the limiting aperture for a {{Duration|quant}} pulse. The energy is {{Energy|quant }}
Power = 20 mW Diameter = 6 mm Duration = 20 ns
#exp = pyMPE.TimedLaserExposure() #exp.setWavelength(Wavelength) #exp.setExposureDuration(Duration) #exp.setPower(Power) #mpe = exp.getMPE(exp) #MPEH = mpe.getRadiantExposure()
Energy = Power * Duration
Energy = Energy
